# gemX — All-in-One HRIS & Payroll Software in the Philippines

> gemX is a complete Human Resource Information System (HRIS) and Payroll platform built specifically for Philippine statutory compliance (BIR Form 2316 & Alphalist, SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, TRAIN Law tax, 13th month pay, and DOLE labor rules), biometric attendance, employee self-service, and multi-company groups.

## Key Product Modules & Canonical Pages
- [gemX | All-in-One HRIS & Payroll Software in the Philippines](https://gemx.ph/): Simplify Philippine payroll & HR with gemX. 100% BIR Form 2316, SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG & DOLE compliant HRIS with biometrics, mobile self-service & multi-company hub.
- [Core HR & Digital 201 Files Software Philippines | gemX HRIS](https://gemx.ph/products/core-hr): Organize employee 201 files, live org charts, job movements, onboarding checklists, exit clearances & DOLE 30-day Final Pay in one paperless Philippine HRIS.
- [Philippine Payroll Software (BIR 2316, SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG) | gemX](https://gemx.ph/products/payroll): Close accurate Philippine payroll cutoffs in minutes. Built-in TRAIN Law tax, SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, 13th month ₱90K ceiling, BIR 2316, Alphalist & bank/wallet payouts.
- [Biometric Time & Attendance, Shift & Leave Software PH | gemX](https://gemx.ph/products/time-attendance): Connect ZKTeco biometrics, GPS selfie mobile clock-ins, rotating shifts, night differentials, local city holidays & leave balances straight into Philippine payroll.
- [Recruitment ATS & Paperless Onboarding Software Philippines | gemX](https://gemx.ph/products/recruitment): Launch a branded careers portal, track applicants visually, send digital job offers & convert hires into complete 201 employee profiles before Day One.
- [Performance Management, 360° Reviews & LMS Philippines | gemX](https://gemx.ph/products/talent-learning): Run KPI & OKR goal alignment, 360-degree performance appraisals, 9-Box talent grids, merit matrix planning & online employee training courses in one HR platform.
- [Employee Benefits, HMO LOA, Asset & DOLE Relations Software | gemX](https://gemx.ph/products/benefits-assets): Manage HMO enrollments, fast Hospital LOA requests, QR-tagged laptop & asset handovers, and DOLE twin-notice employee relations workflows in one place.
- [Multi-Company & Multi-Branch HRIS for Philippine Groups | gemX](https://gemx.ph/features/multi-company): Manage multiple sister companies and nationwide branches from one executive hub while keeping each entity’s payroll, TIN/SSS, branding & 201 records 100% separate.
- [Employee & Manager Mobile Self-Service HR App Philippines | gemX](https://gemx.ph/features/self-service): Give Filipino employees & managers 24/7 mobile and web access to payslips, BIR 2316, leave balances, GPS selfie clock-in, overtime & 1-tap team approvals.
- [WorkPulse Hybrid & WFH Time Tracking & Productivity PH | gemX](https://gemx.ph/features/workpulse): Support hybrid and work-from-home teams in the Philippines with transparent focus insights, active hours & project timesheets connected straight to gemX Payroll.
- [Instant Payroll Disbursement (Maya, PayMongo & PH Banks) | gemX](https://gemx.ph/features/salary-payouts): Disburse approved net salaries in minutes via Maya Business, PayMongo digital wallets, or ready-to-upload Philippine corporate bank payroll advice files.
- [HRIS & Payroll ROI & Time-Savings Calculator Philippines | gemX](https://gemx.ph/roi-calculator): Estimate how many monthly HR hours, paper forms, and payroll cutoff days your Philippine team reclaims by switching from manual spreadsheets to gemX HRIS.
- [Book a Free Live Demo | gemX Philippine HRIS & Payroll](https://gemx.ph/request-demo): Schedule a personalized 30-minute walkthrough with a Philippine HR & Payroll specialist tailored to your shifts, statutory compliance, branches & headcount.
